about.title: Why Score67 exists
about.p1: Score67 is a scoreboard app built with Flutter web. I vibe-coded it for fun: my son plays basketball, and at many games nobody knows the exact score. The scorer's table runs the InGame app, which has no real sharing features and leaves parents, fans and everybody outside the gym in the dark.
about.p2: As a football coach I also use it for kids' football games. One of the next steps is a physical scoreboard over Bluetooth or Wi-Fi, so the score is also visible on the pitch or in the gym.
about.p3: It would be great if more people tested and used the app and shared their experience. I'm happy to build more features and integrations – just write in the forum.
features.title: What Score67 does
features.intro: Free, no account, in the browser – controlled from a phone, followed from anywhere.
features.scoring.title: Live scoring
features.scoring.text: Football and basketball: goals, baskets (1/2/3 points), free throws with hit/miss, rebounds, team and personal fouls, technical fouls, yellow and red cards, penalties, free kicks and timeouts – for the team or individual players.
features.clock.title: Time tracking
features.clock.text: Countdown in basketball, running clock in football. Any period format (1–12 × 1–120 minutes, presets like 4×10, 8×5, 2×45), overtime, set and correct the clock, automatic end for forgotten games.
features.share.title: WhatsApp sharing & more
features.share.text: Share the live link via WhatsApp, Facebook, copy link or the phone's share menu. Spectators need no app and no account.
features.obs.title: OBS overlay
features.obs.text: Transparent overlay for live streams: small or large, left or right, hideable, automatic large view in breaks and at full time, adjustable broadcast delay.
features.ticker.title: Viewer for spectators
features.ticker.text: Score and time in large type on any screen or TV in the gym. The extended view shows scorers, points per player, period scores and the game log.
features.directory.title: All games at a glance
features.directory.text: The live directory lists all public running games, those in the next 72 hours and the ones just finished with their final score – with venue and livestream link.
features.console.title: Controller on your phone
features.console.text: Landscape console: action first, then the player. A warning when a period has not been started, undo, game log, confirm the final result, switch between Controller and Viewer with one tap. Entries survive a weak connection.
features.squad.title: Squads, lineups, teams
features.squad.text: Up to 40 players per team with number and name, paste a list, tap players on court or to the bench, substitutions in the game log. Team names, short names, colours and logos.
features.devices.title: Several devices, PIN, sign-in
features.devices.text: Six-digit PIN, allow or revoke more devices. Optional email sign-in to have your scoreboards on every device.
features.manage.title: Plan and manage games
features.manage.text: Kick-off time, description, venue with map, private games. "My scoreboards" with planned, running and finished games, archive and trash.
features.displays.title: Scoreboard displays
features.displays.text: Show the Viewer on a TV, projector or tablet in the gym, drive LED displays over Bluetooth straight from the phone (Chrome on Android) – and see any game in the LED preview exactly as it would appear on a 64 × 32 LED board.
features.free.title: German and English
features.free.text: The whole app in German and English – no ads, no account, free while in testing.

landing.seo.title: Live ticker and scoreboard for basketball and football
landing.seo.text: With Score67 you record points, goals, fouls, cards and the game clock right on your phone – for basketball (including youth formats such as 8 × 5 minutes) and football from kids' games to 11-a-side. Parents, fans and teammates follow the score live through a link, e.g. via WhatsApp, with no app and no sign-up.
landing.seo.text2: For live streams there is a transparent OBS overlay, for the gym a large display on a TV or projector and LED displays over Bluetooth. After the game, the final score, the game log and a box score per player are ready.
seo.guide.basketball.title: Basketball live ticker & score app for youth games · Score67
seo.guide.basketball.description: Keep the basketball score on your phone and share it live: points, free throws, fouls, game clock (including 8 × 5), box score per player. Free, no app, no account.
seo.guide.football.title: Live ticker for kids' and youth football – share the score live · Score67
seo.guide.football.description: Record goals, cards and the match minute on your phone and share them live via WhatsApp – for 5, 7, 9 or 11 players. Free, no app, shirt numbers instead of names.
seo.guide.obs.title: Scoreboard overlay for OBS and live streams · Score67
seo.guide.obs.description: Transparent score overlay for OBS Studio and Streamlabs: add it as a browser source, control it live from your phone, small or large, with stream delay.
seo.guide.display.title: Scoreboard from your phone – score on a TV, projector or LED · Score67
seo.guide.display.description: Turn any screen into a scoreboard: control the score from your phone and show it large on a TV, projector, tablet or Bluetooth LED display.
seo.guide.whatsapp.title: Share the score live on WhatsApp – how-to · Score67
seo.guide.whatsapp.description: Share the live score with the parents' group in three steps: create a scoreboard, send the link via WhatsApp, tap in the points. No app, no sign-up.
seo.guide.led.title: Build an LED scoreboard: 64×32 LED panel with ESP32 · Score67
seo.guide.led.description: Build guide with parts list: Waveshare P5 64×32 LED panel, Adafruit Matrix Portal S3 (ESP32-S3) and a 5 V supply – a no-solder score display for Score67.
